name: What are the advantages of stripping siding down to the sheathing versus installing new siding over existing material?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of stripping siding down to the sheathing versus installing new siding over existing material?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stripping siding down to the sheathing offers several key advantages. It allows for a thorough inspection of the building's exterior walls, revealing and enabling repairs for any hidden rot, water damage, or structural issues. This method ensures a perfectly flat and sound surface for the new siding, which is crucial for proper installation and longevity. Installing new siding over existing material can trap moisture, hide problems, and lead to an uneven finish, potentially voiding manufacturer warranties. Stripping provides a fresh start, maximizing the performance and aesthetic appeal of your new siding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stripping siding to the sheathing allows for inspection and repair of hidden damage, ensuring a flat, sound surface for new siding. Installing over old siding can hide issues and lead to an uneven finish.
